description: Original, finite prose-review candidate rules. A match is not an error, an authorship claim, or a recommendation to replace a term.

vocabulary.note: Check whether the contractual metaphor identifies a real agreement or only renames ordinary requirements.
A precise scope or evidence limitation can be necessary; check what the phrase adds in this context.
Check whether the reader can identify the actual result or record meant by this phrase.
Context-sensitive technical terminology: retain it when it is the correct term for the subject; its presence is not a prose fault.
Check whether a concrete verb would tell the reader what the analysis does.
Check the purpose and precision of this metaphor; literal uses are ordinary.
Check whether the distinctions are explained rather than only asserted.
Check whether the relevant facets are named.
Check whether the sentence states an evidenced implication; technical and literal uses can be precise.
Check the basis and scope of the importance claim.
Check what changed and whether the claimed importance is supported.
Check whether the described care is relevant and demonstrated.
Check which parts and relationships the claimed scope actually includes.
Context-sensitive technical adjective: identify the tested conditions; robust is legitimate terminology in many fields.
Check whether the relationship is explained concretely.
Check whether this preface helps the intended reader or delays the point.
Check whether the enabling action and beneficiary are specific.
Retain a real feedback-loop meaning; check repeated metaphorical use.
Alignment can be technical or organizational; check whether repeated uses name the actual action.
Reuse can be precise; review repetition in context.
Check the actual level of detail or unit being discussed.
Check who coordinates which actions and whether repetition adds information.
Check whether the mechanism is clear; retain the technical financial or mechanical sense when relevant.
Check whether the claimed joint benefit is explained.
Check the scale and evidence of the claimed change.
Check which practical outcome changed.
Check the actual scope and relationships considered.
Check which decision or action the insight supports.
Check whether the phrase is useful to this audience or can name the analysis more directly.
Check whether the preface adds something beyond the point that follows.
Check whether the conclusion synthesizes evidence or merely repeats it; a match cannot decide that.
Check that each stated consequence follows; frequent use may still be appropriate.
Examples are often useful; review only whether repeated signposting serves the reader.
Check what the emphasis distinguishes in each occurrence.
Check whether a real correction or contrast needs this emphasis.
Check whether the frequency claim is appropriate to the evidence.
Check whether this signals useful uncertainty or avoids a concrete description.
Check the evidence and time frame for the trend.
Check whether a precise explanation supports the claimed essence.
Check whether this degree of certainty is necessary and justified.

syntax.note: Split negation and assertion: check whether the rejected alternative is relevant and whether the positive claim is informative.
Split negation and assertion: check whether both parts are useful to the reader.
Contrast template: review the actual distinction; the structure can be warranted.
Contrast template: check whether the alternatives establish a meaningful distinction.
Importance claim: check the scale, evidence, and concrete consequence in context.

syntax.pattern: (?<![\w])(?:marking a pivotal moment(?: in history)?|play(?:s|ed|ing)? a crucial role(?: in)?|underscor(?:e|es|ed|ing) (?:its|their|the) importance)(?![\w])
syntax.note: Importance claim: check the evidence and consequence; the syntax alone cannot establish exaggeration.

formatting.note: Bold label list item: check whether repeated labels improve scanning for this audience; formatting is not an authorship signal.
